items.title: How (and why) to build agent-first apps
items.excerpt: Builder.io's Steve Sewell lays out an 'agent-native' design pattern where anything the UI can do, an agent can do too -- unifying human and agent actions through a shared action abstraction. A forward-looking take on how product/UX design must change when AI agents become first-class users of the interface.

items.title: Game AI Expert Explains Where AI Actually Belongs in Game Development—And The Risks
items.excerpt: AI researcher Luke Dicken (ex-Zynga innovation lead, former Head of AI at Take-Two) argues generative AI's real value is enabling adaptive, player-facing experiences rather than automating existing content pipelines, and that studios should invest in R&D that amplifies creative talent instead of replacing it. A creative-tooling perspective on where AI helps craft versus where it just adds risk.

items.title: Nexthena 1.2.1 released
items.excerpt: Release notes for Nexthena 1.2.1, an AI-assisted infinite-canvas whiteboard/design tool, adding new workflow and localization updates. A small but concrete example of AI moving into the everyday visual-collaboration and diagramming layer of a designer's toolkit.
